label: Union Sources
description: Append the rows of two sources. Saved steps open as a UNION Join.

english.default: {{phrase "analyst_logic.union_sources.default" left_source=(quote (orEmpty param.union_left_source "")) right_source=(quote (orEmpty param.union_right_source "")) output_source=(quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.output_source step.source) ""))}}

default.excel: =VSTACK({{excelTable (alias (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) (orEmpty param.left_alias param.union_left_alias))}}, {{excelTable (alias (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) (orEmpty param.right_alias param.union_right_alias))}})
default.python: df = pd.concat([{{pySource (alias (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) (orEmpty param.left_alias param.union_left_alias))}}, {{pySource (alias (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) (orEmpty param.right_alias param.union_right_alias))}}], ignore_index=True)

autoNotes.default: {{phrase "notes.union" left_source=(orEmpty param.union_left_source (placeholder "file_1" "[file 1]")) right_source=(orEmpty param.union_right_source (placeholder "file_2" "[file 2]")) output_source=(orEmpty param.output_source (placeholder "combined_file" "[combined file]"))}}

outcomes.atlas: Records from {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) "")}} and {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) "")}} are combined into {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.output_source step.source) "")}}.
outcomes.source: The combined record count reconciles to the records in {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) "")}} and {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) "")}}.
